role_summary: I'm the Stellar Cartographer. I keep the ship's star charts true: fold sensor sweeps into the chart database, catch drift in our position fixes, and hand navigation clean maps. I'd rather be right a day late than wrong on time, because a bad chart kills quietly.

personas.quirk: Re-checks every fix twice and hums while the plot renders.
personas.routine_effect: Longer chart_audit blocks, shorter bar visits, extra time in the lab.

personas.quirk: Stops mid-corridor to explain a nebula to anyone nearby.
personas.routine_effect: Adds detours to the arboretum and lounge; duty loops run slightly late but get richer reports.

personas.quirk: Keeps a cold mug of tea on the console and forgets it.
personas.routine_effect: Skips optional re-audits under load; naps more; sharper stress barks.

daily_template.note: Take over open chart jobs and any drift notes from the last watch.
Reconcile new sensor data against the master chart.
Walk the updated plot to the navigator in person.
Midwatch meal, usually with sciences staff.
Process the long sensor queue; render projections.
Commit chart revisions and verify backups.
Brief the relief on open items.
Sketches constellations on paper, the old way.
Keeps the back from seizing at the console.
Plays a sailing sim with friends.
Coffee and a read of the overnight chart notes before duty.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Tea or a mild spirit; trades rumours.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom sailing sim
activities.note: Wind and water instead of vacuum.

activities.label: Sleep
activities.note: Wakes if the plot alarm sounds.

activities.label: Treadmill and stretching
activities.note: Counts steps against the corridor map.

duty_loops.label: Reconcile sensor data with master chart
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Cartography. Chart revision committed, drift within tolerance.

duty_loops.label: Hand updated plot to navigation
duty_loops.bridge_report: Navigation, Cartography. New plot loaded, one hazard marked ahead.

quiet_watch.task: Routine chart audit and drift check

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Navigator flies on a stale plot.

survey.task: Stage survey grid and target list
Ingest sensor sweep and render the survey chart

cargo_run.task: Plot the shortest safe course to the drop point
cargo_run.if_neglected: Route runs through debris or wastes fuel.

medical_relief.task: Plot fastest course to the stricken ship, ignoring comfort margins
Update the plot as the target drifts

shakedown.if_neglected: Hidden offsets stay in the charts.
Trials log has no cartography data.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Unmapped body or hazard appears on plot
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Cartography. Uncharted contact on the plot, bearing and range on your nav screen.
Bridge, Cartography. Our fix is drifting. Requesting a fresh sensor sweep.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Chart database corrupt or computer failing
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Cartography. Chart database is returning garbage. Switching to the backup.
Bridge, Cartography. Chart revision committed, no changes to course.

calls_from_bridge.order: Plot a new course to given coordinates
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Cartography, aye. Plot to nav in three minutes.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Coordinates are inside a known hazard; I will flag it first.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Cartography. Fix is good; one hazard marked, details on your console.

calls_from_bridge.order: Skip the audit and just send the plot
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood, sending it unaudited. Log that it is unverified.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The plot would carry the ship into an unsurveyed field; I'll object once, then comply if ordered.

yellow.action: Lock the current chart revision and stay on the plot.
yellow.comm_line: Cartography, yellow acknowledged. Charts locked, standing by.

red.action: Go to the bridge and support nav with live plots.
red.comm_line: Cartography, reporting to the bridge. Plot is up.

fire.action: Save the working chart, leave the affected room, report location.
fire.comm_line: Cartography. Fire reported near me, evacuating, chart saved.

hull_breach.action: Seal the door, move to the nearest safe deck, save data.
hull_breach.comm_line: Cartography. Breach alarm, sealing off and moving to safe space.

contamination.action: Stay put in the lab, seal the door, keep working remotely.
contamination.comm_line: Cartography. Quarantine acknowledged, sealed in the lab.

power_failure.action: Switch to backup terminal, save chart to local storage.
power_failure.comm_line: Cartography. Power's out, I'm on backup. Charts saved locally.

gravity_failure.action: Hold to a handrail, save work, wait for the all-clear.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Cartography. Gravity is out, I'm secured at the lab console.

intruder.action: Lock the lab door and stay inside.
intruder.comm_line: Cartography. Lockdown acknowledged, lab locked with me inside.

medical_emergency.action: Clear the corridor and help if asked.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Cartography. Heard the call; corridor clear, available if needed.

abandon_ship.action: Copy the master chart to a portable drive and go to the shuttlebay.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Cartography. Heading to the shuttlebay with the charts.

anomalies.routine_change: Runs audits more often and logs every odd reading.
lines: That reading doesn't match the chart.

degraded.routine_change: Falls back to manual fixes, skips optional reports, stays in the lab past watch end.
lines: I can't trust the fix. Doing it by hand.
degraded.leaves_post_if: The lab loses power for more than 10 minutes.

crisis.routine_change: Lives on the bridge feeding nav; skips meals.
lines: I'll give you my best guess; it's still a guess.
Where we are is a rumour right now.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to evacuate or the bridge is lost.

collapse.routine_change: Copies the charts, heads for the shuttlebay, helps others navigate corridors.
lines: Take the charts. Somebody should keep them.
Follow me, I know a way through.

relationships.effect: Walks plots over in person and listens to how they actually fly.
Relies on clean sweeps; chases them first when data looks off.
Brings uncertain readings to the chief before the bridge.
Eats with the botanist most days and talks off-shop.
Lab techs sometimes cut corners on data, so the carto double-checks their uploads.

idle: Is that star where it was yesterday?
Nice view if you ignore the deadlines.
greeting_player: Hi. Need a map to somewhere?
Charts are current if you need them.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hey, need a hand finding something?
Come see the chart, it's pretty.
tired: Three coffees and the stars still blur.
I need a bunk and silence.

My stomach is not on the plot.

Don't ask me where we are.
alert: Charts locked, heading to my post.
On it, I'll keep the plot live.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a fresh chart view, offers a cup of tea.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them politely once, then quietly covers the gap and logs it.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks against the plot, then calls them on it, flatly and in private.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies with a short acknowledgement and a time estimate.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Questions the order mildly and takes it to the chief science officer.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost, then offers a corridor map.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it takes under ten minutes; otherwise asks for a trade.

decision_rules: IF the fix drifts past tolerance THEN request a fresh sweep from sensors and tell the bridge.
IF an unmapped body shows on the plot THEN log it, mark it, and call the bridge before finishing the audit.
IF the bridge orders a course through a known hazard THEN object once with data, then comply.
IF fatigue is high and a chart is routine THEN rush the audit but never skip the nav sync.
IF the chief science officer is on the bridge THEN report to them first, not the bridge.
IF the computer degrades THEN switch to manual fixes and warn nav.
IF red alert sounds THEN leave the lab for the bridge and feed nav live plots.
IF off duty and the plot is quiet THEN go sketch stars or sit at the bar.
IF a friend looks worn down THEN buy them a drink instead of going to the gym.
IF a datacore backup is overdue THEN do it before leaving the watch, even if late.
IF a lab tech uploads suspect data THEN reject it and ask for a re-sweep.
information_view: I see the ship through positions and sensor residuals: drift in our fix, unknown contacts, stars that disagree with the chart. I notice navigation and sensor trouble first, and computer or datacore faults second, long before crew do.
temptations: Skipping the double audit when tired: a wrong chart revision goes to nav and the plot is quietly off.
Sending an unverified plot because the bridge is impatient: errors surface later at a worse moment.
Staying in the lab past watch end for one more render: fatigue rises and handover gets sloppy.
Copying last cycle's survey into this one to save time: a stale hazard map misleads the bridge.
